items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: Last job I played, I played with John Casme.

ctx.x: So now they come and tell me. So Remus, Remus, he wouldn't take his money. He wouldn't take the money. He went to the union. So the union made him pay, paid him his full, you know what I mean, schedule, you know what you call it, full money. See, the $30, or $32, $30 was what it was and all. So Remus got disgusted. Last job I played, I played with John Casme. I didn't play the gang of that, because I used to give John a lot of parades too, you see, and things fumes too. So the last one I played was uptown, way…
Maybe a parade start up at Audubon Park. Yeah, we up there somewhere.
